data: Which of the methods, in '(b) Wikidata' plot have a cumulative distribution of 8 at degree 5?

The question asks which method in the 'Wikidata' plot has a cumulative distribution of 8 at degree 5. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the degree distributions of entity alignment datasets extracted by different methods. The 'Wikidata' plot is shown in subfigure (b). 

Looking at the 'Wikidata' plot, we can see four lines representing different methods: DBpedia, SRPRS (normal), BootEA, and MTransE. We need to identify which line reaches a cumulative distribution value of approximately 0.8 at degree 5.

By examining the graph, the SRPRS (normal) line appears to reach a cumulative distribution of about 0.8 at degree 5. Therefore, the method in the 'Wikidata' plot that has a cumulative distribution of 8 at degree 5 is SRPRS (normal).
